{{ // photo-card partial — renders ONE photo as + caption, // pulling responsive variants via the imageVariants + srcset // builtins. Provided as a convenience for layouts that want to // render photos outside the masonry grid. // // Input data shape (call as `partial 'photo-card' p`): // .src — image path (required) // .alt — alt text (optional; falls back to .caption) // .caption — caption shown under the image (optional) // .href — click-through URL (optional; defaults to original) // .sizes — `sizes` attribute (optional; sane default supplied) // // Markup uses one per format with a full multi-width // srcset so the browser actually picks the right variant. }} {{ src := if .src then .src else . }} {{ alt := if .alt then .alt else (if .caption then .caption else '') }} {{ v := imageVariants src }} {{ href := if .href then .href else v.original }} {{ sizes := if .sizes then .sizes else '(min-width: 96rem) 25vw, (min-width: 64rem) 33vw, (min-width: 40rem) 50vw, 100vw' }} {{ webp := srcset src 'webp' }} {{ orig := srcset src 'original' }}
